# hrppl

> hrppl is a global HRMS, payroll and practice management platform for finance and HR teams. Multi-country payroll, compliant payslips, performance reviews, and a full developer API.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and pricing for the hrppl platform.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles and guides on global payroll, HR strategy, and product updates.
- [Careers](/careers): Open roles across the organisation.
- [Help Center](/help): How-to guides, videos and support resources.
